name: EXIT (green guide)
spec: green horizontal rectangle with white legend EXIT 24 and a white arrow
meaning: Marks the exit ramp from a freeway.

snippets.back: A pedestrian should not begin crossing on a nearly expired green signal or a steady or flashing don't-walk indication.
A green signal permits travel through the intersection only after conflicting traffic has cleared.
Red, yellow and green signal lights stand at many intersections to control the direction and flow of traffic.
A green signal permits the indicated movement only when another sign or signal does not restrict it.
A green signal permits movement only when safe after stopping for pedestrians and yielding to vehicles already in the intersection.

To leave the freeway watch the exit signs, signal, move into the exit lane, keep your speed until you are completely on the exit ramp and then slow smoothly, and if you miss your exit never stop or back up but continue to the next exit.
A green signal permits movement only after yielding to vehicles and pedestrians already in the crossing or intersection.
A green sign shows permitted movements, directions or guidance, such as highway entrances and exits or the distance to destinations ahead.

result.summary: IN states green signs give guidance for highway entrances and exits, and HI directs drivers leaving the freeway to watch the exit signs, consistent with a green exit guide marking the freeway exit ramp.
